item.text: {"decisions":[{"decision_id":"8d6b689bea32a76ddc3b-1","relevant":1,"confidence":"high","reason":"說明客戶端驗證伺服器憑證時的主機檢查與根 CA 信任設定，符合 TLS 信任配置規則。","evidence":"The self-signed root CA certificate needs to be stored either in the file specified with CAfile, or in the directory specified with CApath."},{"decision_id":"d921d21db7b59ac76c03-1","relevant":0,"confidence":"high","reason":"內容為 TLS 隧道與憑證設定，未說明以工作階段金鑰記錄解密封包的分析流程。","evidence":"In order to provide TLS encapsulation to your local imapd service, use:"},{"decision_id":"8dc7b1dd0ebfb98e4a31-0","relevant":0,"confidence":"high","reason":"介紹 Metasploit 漏洞檢查方法，未提供 Android Java 方法插樁或掛鉤功能。","evidence":"In Metasploit, exploits and auxiliary modules support the check command that allows the user to be able to determine the vulnerable state before using the module."},{"decision_id":"c2a9df41e439d8534bca-0","relevant":0,"confidence":"high","reason":"內容為漏洞狀態檢查與檢查碼，未記載 APK 資源的擷取、解碼或檢視。","evidence":"Once you have determined the vulnerable state, you should return a check code."},{"decision_id":"bfe711ad5b986e32634f-0","relevant":1,"confidence":"high","reason":"解釋 SYN 掃描如何判讀無回應，並提供以 SYN 掃描為基礎的自訂旗標用法。","evidence":"For example, a SYN scan considers no-response indicative of a filtered port, while a FIN scan treats the same as open|filtered ."},{"decision_id":"39ee584aa32856411fcc-0","relevant":0,"confidence":"high","reason":"介紹 Nmap 輸出格式與除錯選項，未解釋 UDP 掃描行為、用法或結果判讀。","evidence":"So Nmap offers several formats, including the interactive mode for humans to read directly and XML for easy parsing by software."}]}
